text:
anna: Recap from today's design review re: in-console docs panel and terminology. Leaving notes so we have an action list.

anna: Major items: UI vs docs label mismatches, missing anchors in docs when opened from console, and a couple a11y/help-panel bugs.

anna: Terminology examples: console shows `Model revision` in the model details drawer, docs & API use `model version`. Also sidebar uses `Routes` while docs say `Endpoints`.

evan: I'm +1 on standardizing to `model version` (API parity).

liam: For `Routes` vs `Endpoints` we should pick one but show the alt term in smaller text (e.g., `Routes (Endpoints)`), since some customers expect the word "endpoint".

rachel: Copy suggestion for drawer label: `Model version — the exact model weights and config used for inference. See docs.` I'll open a small PR to canonicalize copy.

anna: In-product docs panel: right now it's an iframe of docs without stable fragment IDs. When you click "Help" from a model page the panel lands at the top and users can't share the deep link. We should: add stable fragment IDs to headings, show docs version in the panel header, and provide an "Open in docs" external link.

liam: Engineering note: adding id attributes for h2/h3 is straightforward in the docs build. We can also generate a small JSON mapping of `console_slug -> docs_fragment` for explicit routing.

matt: Will add canonical link meta and a `data-docs-version` attribute at build time. Also will create a tiny docs-tooling ticket to emit the mapping file liam mentioned.

docs-bot: Auto-check: /console/models currently contains `model revision` in 3 places (v1.4). https://docs.redwood.ai/console/models#diff-issues

evan: Can docs pipeline emit a lint warning when UI strings (from the i18n/strings file) diverge from the docs copy? That would catch these earlier.

docs-bot: Feature request logged: docs-string-lint. Priority: P3.

anna: A11y/help panel: keyboard users can't reliably close the panel with `Esc`. Focus sometimes gets trapped. Also code blocks inside the panel don't have a copy-to-clipboard affordance.

rachel: I can add an a11y test to cover Esc and focus return. For copy we should mirror the console codeblock copy button. I'll include copy button in the docs PR.

liam: Telemetry: propose event `docs_panel.open` with properties {`source_path`, `docs_fragment`, `docs_version`}. This will let us measure how often deep links are used.

evan: SGTM. analytics will add `docs_panel_open` and `help_source` props.

matt: Question: should the panel show semver or commit SHA? My preference: semver visible, SHA on hover/expanded view.

anna: Semver on surface, SHA in hover — agreed. Add this to the UI spec.

rachel: Draft link pattern for copy:```https://docs.redwood.ai/console/models#model-version``` I'll use `model-version` as the canonical fragment.

docs-bot: Suggestion: add an automated check that verifies the fragment exists before letting a console deploy reference it.

liam: I'll create the tickets: docs-tooling (add ids + mapping file + canonical link), console (header + Open in docs + docs version + highlight-on-open + Esc behavior + copy button), analytics (event + schema).

matt: I'll include screenshots and an accessibility checklist in the console PR template.

rachel: PR opened for copy canonicalization: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/519 — swaps `model revision` -> `model version` and adds initial fragment IDs.

anna: Owners: rachel (copy/docs PR), liam (docs-tooling work + console small changes), matt (CI/meta + PR template), evan (analytics schema).

anna: Thanks team — small changes but should cut a lot of onboarding questions. Ping here when PRs are up. :thumbsup:

matt: noted, will link tickets when ready.

docs-bot: Next docs sync reminder: Fri 10:00.

anna: closing loop.
